issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): update_handler split imports 6 private helpers across its new modules
issue.description: Found by the sase-zf land agent's required post-close `just symvision` run. `just symvision` (and therefore the `_lint-symvision` gate inside `just check`) fails on clean master 26d84256a: "Private functions/classes should not be imported" for 13 entries. Root cause: untagged commit 843e4b8b8 "refactor(update): split update_handler.py into focused modules" split src/sase/main/update_handler.py but kept underscore-private names imported across the new module boundaries — update_handler.py imports _handle_dry_run/_handle_live_update/_handle_mode_switch and update_handler_dry_run.py imports _call_plan_dev_update/_fail/_tool_python from update_handler_support.py. Symvision's name-based matching then also flags the same-named private definitions in pipe_handler.py, plugins/cli_install.py, plugins/cli_update.py, plugins/cli_uninstall.py, and tmux_agent/cli.py, which are only used locally. Fix per the symvision reference memory: make the genuinely cross-module symbols public in the new update_handler_* modules (rename without the leading underscore) rather than whitelisting; the collateral same-named locals should then clear on their own. Same failure class as closed tasks sase-tb/sase-ta (private imports across freshly split modules) but a different split and root commit.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint over source text: two consecutive just symvision runs on the same clean tree fail identically, naming the same 13 private-import definitions; the cross-module private imports are visible in the committed source (src/sase/main/update_handler.py:33-35, update_handler_dry_run.py:10) introduced by 843e4b8b8.

payload.entry: CORROBORATING SOURCE EVIDENCE from sase-yy.8.6.2 note #1: at primary 2b811499c, update_handler.py still imports _handle_dry_run/_handle_live_update/_handle_mode_switch across modules and dry_run still imports _call_plan_dev_update/_fail/_tool_python from update_handler_support. Same root cause and required repair as this task; no new task or claimed fresh Symvision run.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during continuation_capture package split verification at 62ad9b657: after fixing continuation_capture package Symvision private imports, just check passed fmt python, fmt markdown, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, feature flags, pyscripts, test waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed lint (symvision) only on the same update_handler private-import cluster tracked here (_call_plan_dev_update, _completion_refresh_after_update, _fail, _handle_dry_run, _handle_live_update, _handle_mode_switch, _render_completion_refresh, _tool_python, plus collateral same-named local helpers). The new continuation_capture package no longer appears in Symvision output, and focused continuation/audit tests passed 11/11. Deterministic static lint failure, not a flake.

Independent reproduction during test_repo_handler_open split verification: focused repo-open tests passed through just test (18 passed), then required just check passed fmt python, fmt markdown, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, feature flags, pyscripts, test waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology before failing lint (symvision) at just _lint-symvision. Failure output names the same private-import cluster already tracked here, including _call_plan_dev_update, _completion_refresh_after_update, _fail, _handle_dry_run, _handle_live_update, _handle_mode_switch, _render_completion_refresh, _tool_python, and collateral same-named locals in pipe_handler/plugins/tmux. Local diff only touches tests/main repo-open test files and repo_handler_helpers.py; src/sase has no diff, so this is deterministic static lint debt, not a flake or caused by this turn.
